title: Demon Game for Sophie.
author: Milo van Mesdag
description:
A game I wrote for someone who'll never see it.

A story I never intended to tell.

Or a game about being a demon on a murderous quest to bring order back to a broken world. Because I can't force you to listen.

Content warning: Suicide, gore, animal abuse. Full content warning in game.

(There is also one instance of flashing images, but the player is given the chance to opt out of it before it occurs.)
